name: agent-review
description: Runs Mark Russinovich's Agent Review (a GitHub Copilot canvas) unmodified in Claude Code: review agent-made changes from architecture down to source diffs

model.title: Model for explanations
model.description: Writes the overview, summaries, file explanations and discussion answers. A model name such as sonnet, or session for the model of the session that opened the review

reviewModel.title: Model for review passes
reviewModel.description: Looks for defects in the change and verifies the candidates. A model name such as opus, or session. Upstream cancels a pass that takes over two minutes

effort.title: Effort for explanations
effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Upstream allows each request two minutes
